title: 加载与保存时间过长
description: 游戏加载、保存及区域切换耗时过长，影响玩家等待体验。
evidence: Load times are still too long
The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save
The load screens are a nightmare

evidence_items.quote: they take a while to pack and unpack, which makes loading and saving the game take a while, even on a SSD
evidence_items.description: 存档打包和解包耗时，导致加载和保存缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它们打包和解包需要一段时间，这使得加载和保存游戏也要花上一段时间，即使是在固态硬盘上也是如此

evidence_items.description: 保存时间极长

evidence_items.description: 保存和加载时间很长

evidence_items.description: 加载时间过长

evidence_items.description: 3天存档运行非常慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 一个3天的存档运行得非常慢

evidence_items.description: 保存游戏耗时较长

evidence_items.quote: the key problem at the moment are load times
evidence_items.description: 加载时间过长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 目前的关键问题是加载时间

evidence_items.quote: Do tego dochodzą długie loadingi
evidence_items.description: 游戏加载时间长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 此外还有漫长的加载时间

evidence_items.quote: loading times
evidence_items.description: 加载时间长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载时间

evidence_items.quote: the game freezes every time it saves
evidence_items.description: 每次保存时游戏冻结
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏每次存档时都会卡死

evidence_items.quote: Load times are still too long
evidence_items.description: 加载时间过长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载时间仍然太长

evidence_items.quote: saving takes ages and sometimes completely hangs
evidence_items.description: 保存耗时很长，有时完全卡住
evidence_items.quote_zh: 保存要花很长时间，有时还会完全卡死

evidence_items.quote: saving and loading (saves gets broken sometimes) take ages
evidence_items.description: 保存和加载耗时很长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 保存和加载（存档有时会损坏）要花很长时间

evidence_items.quote: Insane loading times (partially fixable with Nexus mods).
evidence_items.description: 加载时间极长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 疯狂的加载时间（部分可通过Nexus模组修复）。

evidence_items.quote: the save files are a complete joke being compress to save on size over speed using JSON
evidence_items.description: 存档文件压缩方式导致保存缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 存档文件完全是个笑话，为了节省大小而牺牲速度，使用JSON进行压缩

evidence_items.quote: load and save times are inexplicably slow
evidence_items.description: 加载和保存时间异常缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载和保存时间慢得莫名其妙

evidence_items.quote: The load screens are a nightmare
evidence_items.description: 加载画面曾是噩梦，现在仍令人烦躁
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载画面简直是噩梦

evidence_items.quote: Load screens are now downgraded from nightmare to just annoying
evidence_items.description: 加载画面从噩梦降级为只是烦人
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载画面现在从噩梦级降级为只是烦人

evidence_items.quote: Loading/saving (and pretty much everything else) needs to permit alt-tab out so we don't have to sit there staring at a load screen that takes 20 seconds
evidence_items.description: 加载画面耗时20秒且无法alt-tab
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载/保存（以及几乎所有其他操作）需要允许alt-tab切出，这样我们就不必坐在那里盯着一个需要20秒才显示游戏提示的加载屏幕

evidence_items.quote: Loading times between zones break immersion frequently
evidence_items.description: 区域间加载时间频繁破坏沉浸感
evidence_items.quote_zh: 区域之间的加载时间经常破坏沉浸感

evidence_items.quote: The game is also astonishingly slow to load and save
evidence_items.description: 游戏加载和保存极其缓慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏的加载和保存也慢得惊人

evidence_items.quote: saving/loading is slow for such a bare bones game
evidence_items.description: 保存和加载速度慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 对于这么一款内容单薄的游戏来说，保存/加载太慢了

evidence_items.quote: If you are going to force me to sit through 5-10 seconds of lag for each zone switch
evidence_items.description: 区域切换时加载缓慢，有5-10秒的延迟
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你非要逼我每次切换区域都忍受5到10秒的卡顿

evidence_items.quote: make saving and loading much much faster
evidence_items.description: 保存和加载速度很慢，需要大幅加快
evidence_items.quote_zh: 让保存和加载快得多得多

evidence_items.quote: The LONG saving times, are an issue.
evidence_items.description: 保存时间很长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 漫长的保存时间，是个问题。

evidence_items.quote: changeing area even if the area is small seems to take longer than loading huge maps in any other game.
evidence_items.description: 切换区域加载时间过长，即使区域很小
evidence_items.quote_zh: 切换区域，即使区域很小，似乎也比在其他任何游戏里加载巨大的地图还要花更长时间。

evidence_items.quote: After the last update, load times are way better
evidence_items.description: 加载时间在最近更新后变好
evidence_items.quote_zh: 上次更新之后，加载时间好多了

evidence_items.quote: It doesn't seem to like Linux or M2 drives, somehow this makes loading very slow.
evidence_items.description: 在Linux或M2硬盘上加载非常慢
evidence_items.quote_zh: 它似乎不太喜欢Linux或M2硬盘，不知怎么的这让加载变得非常慢。

evidence_items.quote: Loading screens could be improved but with such a complicated game it's almost expected.
evidence_items.description: 加载画面可以改进，但考虑到游戏复杂程度几乎在预期之内
evidence_items.quote_zh: 加载画面可以改进，但考虑到游戏如此复杂，这几乎是意料之中的。

evidence_items.quote: autosaving (set to every 1 hour) takes ~45 minutes per save
evidence_items.description: 自动保存耗时极长
evidence_items.quote_zh: 自动存档（设为每1小时一次）每次存档大约需要45分钟

evidence_items.quote_zh: 性能和存档时间相当糟糕
